01 — Deep Learning

Ensemble Deep Learning for Cloud Workload Prediction & Auto-Scaling

PythonLSTMGRUCNNMLP
View on GitHub

About the Project

This project builds an AI-based cloud workload prediction and auto-scaling system for cloud-native applications. An ensemble of LSTM, GRU, CNN, and MLP models predicts next-hour CPU usage, memory, active jobs, and users with 90% accuracy.

The system automatically decides whether to Scale UP, Scale DOWN, or remain STABLE and allocates jobs across available machines in real time. A live dashboard shows resource utilization and 24-hour scaling history.

Key Highlights

• Perfect Ensemble accuracy of 90% achieved after training
• Real-time auto-scaling decisions: Scale UP / DOWN / STABLE
• Live Resource Utilization Dashboard with job allocation per machine
• Model Training Progress tracked with accuracy curve over epochs
• Scaling Decisions chart showing 24-hour history

02 — Exploratory Data Analysis

India Superstore Customer Purchase Behavior Analysis (EDA)

PythonPandasMatplotlibSeaborn
View on GitHub

About the Project

A comprehensive EDA on a retail dataset adapted to the Indian market — currency converted from USD to INR (1 USD = ₹83.5). Covers 9,994 orders from 793 customers across 2014–2017.

The analysis uncovers sales trends, category performance, regional breakdowns, customer segment distribution, seasonal patterns, and the negative impact of high discounts on profit.

Key Insights Found

• Technology leads in both sales (₹6.98 Cr) and profit (₹1.21 Cr)
• Sales spike in Q4 — November biggest month at ₹2.94 Cr
• Gujarat and Maharashtra top states, contributing over ₹6 Cr
• Discounts above 20% consistently produce negative profit
• Consumer segment accounts for 50.6% of all sales
• Furniture has only 2.5% margin vs Technology's 17.4%

03 — End-to-End Analysis

Food Delivery Data Analysis

PythonMySQLPower BISQL
View on GitHub

About the Project

An end-to-end data analysis pipeline studying food delivery time patterns, vehicle performance, traffic impact, and city-wise order distribution. Data was processed in Python and MySQL, then visualized in a Power BI dashboard.

The dashboard reveals that Semi-Urban areas have the longest average delivery times (~45 min), and traffic jams add ~10 minutes. Urban areas account for 77.39% of all orders.

Key Highlights

• Delivery Time by City: Semi-Urban > Metropolitan > Urban
• Vehicle comparison: Motorcycle, Scooter, Electric Scooter
• Traffic density impact analysis: Jam, High, Medium, Low
• Orders Distribution pie chart across cities
• End-to-end pipeline: Python → MySQL → Power BI

04 — Funnel Analytics

E-commerce Funnel Analysis

PythonSQLPower BIAnalytics
View on GitHub

About the Project

A funnel analysis project that tracks user behavior across e-commerce stages — Visit → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase. SQL queries calculate step-by-step conversion rates and identify where users drop off.

The Power BI dashboard visualizes the funnel with a waterfall chart, KPI cards showing total users and revenue, and conversion rates between stages.

Key Highlights

• Full funnel tracked: Visit → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase
• 25% final conversion rate identified
• KPI cards: Count of users and Sum of revenue (13K)
• SQL used to compute step-by-step retention rates
• Power BI for stakeholder-ready visualization
